subject: Privacy discovery: controller/processor confirmation and contract-module preference
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@clearstream.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: privacy discovery call — controller confirmation & contract module options

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from Redwood and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of what we heard
- You confirmed Clearstream will act as the data controller for the integration.
- Key concerns: EU data transfers, retention limits for logs, and SOC 2 evidence for our infra.
- Procurement would like a DPA and a statement on which contract module we expect to use for transfers.

Redwood position / defaults
- Redwood typically operates as a data processor (we process customer data on your behalf).
- We provide a standard Data Processing Agreement (DPA) and support Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) — we typically propose the Processor SCC module (Module II) when the customer is controller and Redwood is processor.
- We can provide an SOC 2 summary and a redacted report under NDA; full SOC 2 report can be shared via secure link or upon NDA request.

Proposed next steps
1) I will send our draft DPA (v0.9) and our vendor security questionnaire for you to review.
2) Please confirm procurement contact and whether Clearstream has a preferred SCC variant (if applicable).
3) If you can return the vendor questionnaire, our compliance team will triage and return SOC 2 evidence and retention detail.
4) Schedule a short follow-up next week to close on contract-module choice and timeline.

Attachments: Redwood DPA - v0.9.pdf (draft), Redwood Vendor Security Questionnaire (blank).xlsx

If that matches your expectations I'll send the attachments now and loop in legal for the DPA review.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0182

---

From: Alice Chen <alice@clearstream.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearstream.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:10:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: privacy discovery call — controller confirmation & contract module options

Thanks, Tessa — appreciated the clear notes. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: Clearstream is the controller for customer data under our integration.
- Procurement contact is procurement@clearstream.com; you can loop them on the DPA.
- For transfers, we prefer the standard EU Standard Contractual Clauses that operate when the customer is the controller and the vendor is a processor. If you have a named "processor module" variant, that should be fine.
- SOC 2: we need at minimum a Type II attestation summary and preferably a path to the redacted report. What timeline do you have?

I've attached our vendor security questionnaire (CS-VendorSecurityQ-2027.xlsx) — it's short. If you can return your completed sections or confirm answers, procurement will accept that as part of the security intake.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Integrations | Clearstream Solutions
alice@clearstream.com
Attachment: CS-VendorSecurityQ-2027.xlsx

---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:20:03 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recap: privacy discovery call — controller confirmation & contract module options

Aditya / Lauren — forwarding the Clearstream notes. They explicitly confirmed controller role and attached their vendor questionnaire. Two asks from procurement: DPA + SCC module choice, and SOC2 evidence.

My recommendation:
- Offer Redwood DPA v0.9 with Standard Contractual Clauses - Processor module (we call this "Module II / Processor SCC"). That aligns with our usual defaults when customer is controller.
- Prepare SOC2 summary stub now; offer redacted report via secure upload after a simple NDA if procurement requests the full doc.
- Complete the CS-VendorSecurityQ internally and return it alongside the DPA to speed procurement review.

Any concerns about module choice or required legal redlines we should anticipate? If Module II is acceptable I can send DPA + questionnaire to procurement and copy legal.

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:05:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Recap: privacy discovery call — controller confirmation & contract module options

Looks good to me. A couple of notes from legal: 
- Module II (Processor SCC) is the correct starting point when the customer is controller and Redwood is acting as a processor.
- Our DPA v0.9 should include the standard data categories and retention language; I will prepare a short addendum that clarifies log retention windows (they asked about that).
- SOC 2: provide the Type II summary now (SOC2-summary-stub.txt) and offer the redacted report behind an NDA. Procurement commonly requests the redacted report; make sure procurement@clearstream.com gets the secure link (we host it on an expiring link).

I'll draft the retention addendum and sign off on the DPA text. Tessa — once you send the DPA + questionnaire to Alice and procurement, cc legal (aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com) and I will engage if redlines come in.

Aditya
General Counsel | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: DPA + questionnaire sent — next steps and proposed contract module

Hi Alice / procurement team,

Following our call and internal review, please find the attachments referenced below: 
- Redwood DPA - v0.9.pdf (draft) — proposed path: Redwood as Processor; Clearstream as Controller. We propose Standard Contractual Clauses (Processor variant, "Module II").
- Redwood Vendor Security Questionnaire (blank).xlsx — we've pre-filled sections 1-3; please complete the remaining vendor-specific fields if you need additional context.
- SOC2-summary-stub.txt — high-level Type II summary. If procurement needs the redacted report we can provision an expiring secure link after a simple mutual NDA.

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm that Module II (Processor SCC) is acceptable for Clearstream.
2) Share procurement contact full name and any vendor intake ID you need us to reference.
3) Return the completed questionnaire (CS-VendorSecurityQ-2027.xlsx fields) or let us know which areas you want us to expand on.

Proposed timeline:
- This week: procurement reviews DPA + questionnaire.
- Early next week: we provide the redacted SOC 2 report link if requested.
- Within two weeks: aim to finalize DPA redlines and confirm module selection.

If that works I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up for next Tuesday to close any open items.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
